source_document.title: FSU Instagram monitoring seed list
source_document.scope: FSU-linked account candidates across departments, campus events, research, cultural organizations and sports clubs. Not an exhaustive directory of student organizations. Includes accounts with limited event relevance.
source_document.monitoring_status: Not configured. Posts, reels and stories access must be tested separately.

research_handle_correction_candidate.note: The submitted fsu_cre candidate may warrant a separate access check; no alias, replacement or activation is inferred.

limits: URL syntax/host checks do not verify destination existence, control, affiliation, current content, redirects or Instagram API eligibility.
Existing watchlist overlaps are recorded as identity matches only; current access evidence belongs to the separate watchlist and live reports.
Possible aliases remain separate unverified candidate rows.
Every imported candidate remains inactive; no monitoring scope, schedule, API budget or credential access was changed.

validation.command:
python3 -c 'import collections,json,re
from urllib.parse import urlsplit
r=json.load(open("config/instagram-candidates.json"))
a=r["accounts"]
assert len(a)==len({x["handle"] for x in a})==209
assert collections.Counter(x["priority"] for x in a)=={"high":29,"standard":180}
assert r["automatic_collection_enabled"] is False and r["calendar_writes_enabled"] is False
for x in a:
 assert re.fullmatch("[a-z0-9._]{1,30}",x["handle"])
 assert x["profile_url"]=="https://www.instagram.com/"+x["handle"]+"/"
 assert x["enabled_in_candidate_registry"] is False
 assert x["attribution_status"]=="user_provided_source_urls_not_fetched_during_import"
 for value in x["source_urls"]:
  u=urlsplit(value)
  assert u.scheme in ("http","https") and (u.hostname=="fsu.edu" or u.hostname.endswith(".fsu.edu"))
  assert not (u.username or u.password or u.fragment or u.port)
assert sum(len(x["source_urls"]) for x in a)==726
assert sum(x["possible_older_alias_of"] is not None for x in a)==3
print("PASS:209 unique candidates;29 high/180 standard;726 FSU source references;3 unmerged alias claims;0 activated;0 network")
'
validation.stdout: PASS:209 unique candidates;29 high/180 standard;726 FSU source references;3 unmerged alias claims;0 activated;0 network
